requires: Artificer level 5, Aether Engineer subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, cross a 300-foot chasm with no bridge using only lift charge, carrying a stranger who cannot fly.
secret: You must have never once fallen from a height while hovering before entering the tower.
notice: [Hidden job change. The wind has signed on as crew.]
blurb: This Aether Engineer stops hovering alone and learns to lift the whole party like kites on one string.
features: Spend 1 stored charge to grant up to three allies within 30 feet a 20-foot hover speed until your next turn.
As a reaction, push a flying or falling creature within 60 feet 15 feet in any direction.
Once per long rest, you and up to six allies gain a 60-foot fly speed for 10 minutes and cannot be knocked prone.
evolves: At level 15, after carrying 100 passengers safely, the tether can lift a Huge vehicle or beast.
cost: Every ally lifted draws on your charge; if it empties mid-flight, everyone drops.

requires: Artificer level 11, Aether Engineer subclass, Navigation profession level 3
unlock: Fly through the Fogglass Spire's mirror-sky on floor 12 and chart all nine of its false horizons on a map you made yourself.
secret: You must have flown through a real thunderstorm at least once and kept your stored charge above half the whole time.
notice: [Hidden job change. The fog has a shape. You can read it now.]
blurb: An engineer who reads air pressure like script, steering lift charge through mist, storm and realm boundaries.
features: You sense Realm Pressure and weather within 1 mile and ignore the first 1 point of Pressure strain while airborne.
While flying you are heavily obscured to creatures more than 30 feet away.
Once per long rest, fly in a straight line up to 1 mile in one action, ending in any visible place, carrying one willing creature.
evolves: At level 21, the charts can map a route between realms, cutting Tower travel time in half.
cost: Clear skies make you dizzy; in windless air you lose your hover speed.

requires: Artificer level 21, Aether Engineer subclass, a Minor contract with a sky or storm god
unlock: Rise to the Choir Spire's 22nd floor without touching a stair, then let the presiding sky god strike your engine once and keep flying.
secret: The god only offers the contract if your engine has never been used to flee from a fight.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your engine runs on borrowed thunder.]
blurb: The engine's stored charge is replaced by a god's lightning, turning lift into a weapon of judgement.
features: Your charges recover on a short rest, and each spent charge adds 2d6 lightning to your next hit.
Hovering 10 feet or higher, you gain +1 AC and resistance to lightning and thunder.
Once per long rest, dive from at least 30 feet onto a point; creatures within 20 feet take 10d10 lightning damage (Dex save half).
evolves: Raising the contract to a Finger lets the engine sustain flight indefinitely.
cost: The god may call you to fly its errands once a month, and refusal grounds you for a week.

requires: Artificer level 5, Alchemist subclass, Alchemy profession level 2
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, brew one elixir from ingredients gathered on every lower floor, then drink it yourself before anyone else.
secret: You must have brewed 100 elixirs and never sold a single one.
notice: [Hidden job change. The flask refuses to run dry.]
blurb: An Alchemist who chases one perfect formula, a flask that refills itself as long as its maker keeps experimenting.
features: Once per short rest, your experimental elixir does not consume a use and you choose its effect.
Potions you brew keep 1 point of their material's Potency as bonus healing or damage.
Once per long rest, drink from the flask to regain all hit points and end one condition on yourself.
evolves: At level 15, if you have recorded 50 original recipes, the flask can brew a spell of 3rd level or lower as a potion.
cost: The flask feeds on curiosity; a week with no new experiment and it goes dry.

requires: Artificer level 21, Alchemist subclass, attuned to Realm Pressure 5
unlock: Descend to floor 43 of the Sunken Spire and distil a drinkable potion from the crushing dark water there.
secret: You must have drunk an untested potion of your own at least 30 times without fail.
notice: [Hidden job change. The deep tastes you back.]
blurb: Brewing from deep realm matter, this Alchemist learns that pressure itself can be bottled and poured.
features: Throw a vial; creatures within 15 feet of impact treat Realm Pressure as 2 higher until your next turn.
Allies who drink your elixir ignore 2 points of Realm Pressure for 1 hour.
Once per long rest, flood a 40-foot cube with abyssal brine; enemies inside are restrained and take 8d10 cold damage each turn (Con save ends).
evolves: Brewing with a Void-grade reagent lets the vials crush realm walls themselves.
cost: You need double water each day, and fresh potions taste of salt and rot to you.

requires: Artificer level 11, Alchemist subclass, Cooking or Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire find a recipe book with your grandmother's handwriting, follow it exactly and serve the dish to the spirit who wrote it.
secret: You must have healed 50 creatures with food or potions and never refused anyone who asked.
notice: [Hidden job change. The kitchen and the laboratory were always the same room.]
blurb: Folk remedies and old wives' cures become real alchemy in this Alchemist's hands, every meal a mild potion.
features: Meals you cook on a short rest grant each eater temporary hit points equal to your Artificer level.
As an action, feed a creature a tonic ending poison, disease or one curse of 4th level or lower.
Ultimate: Feast of the Long Table
Once per long rest, a meal heals up to 10 creatures to full and grants advantage on saves for 8 hours.
evolves: At level 21, the recipes can be written down and taught, creating apprentices who brew at half strength.
cost: You cannot eat food you did not prepare yourself without becoming poisoned.

requires: Artificer level 5, Armorer subclass
unlock: Spend three full days on floor 8 of the Milestone Spire without removing your armor, sleeping and eating inside it.
secret: You must have taken 1,000 total damage while wearing your armor and never once fled.
notice: [Hidden job change. The suit no longer comes off. It has decided to stay.]
blurb: An Armorer whose suit grows into a shell, closer to a hermit crab's home than a set of plate.
features: You can sleep in the armor and gain the benefits of a long rest without removing it.
As a reaction to a hit, reduce its damage by your Intelligence modifier in addition to AC.
Once per long rest, become immune to damage for 1 round, unable to move or act.
evolves: At level 15, the shell grows rooms; one ally can ride inside and gain half cover.
cost: After a week inside, taking it off leaves you poisoned for a day.

requires: Artificer level 21, Armorer subclass, Blacksmithing profession level 5
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor, reforge your armor in a devil's furnace and pay for the fuel with a year of your life.
secret: Your armor must contain at least one Hell-grade material forged by your own hand.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your armor carries a debt. It intends to collect.]
blurb: Plate stamped with an infernal seal that burns anyone who strikes it and records their debt.
features: Creatures that hit you in melee take fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier and are marked.
Your attacks against marked creatures deal an extra 3d8 fire damage.
Once per long rest, every marked creature within 60 feet takes 4d10 fire damage per mark (Con save half).
evolves: Binding a devil into the seal lets the armor fight on its own for 1 minute.
cost: Your armor glows red-hot when you lie, and healing spells on you are halved.

requires: Artificer level 21, Armorer subclass, holds the Shield or Protect Rune
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire, survive one hour as the floors rearrange, rebuilding your armor each time a floor resets.
secret: You must have absorbed at least three different Runes' energy into armor before the trial.
notice: [Hidden job change. The plates rearrange. They still hold.]
blurb: An Armorer whose suit is lined with a Rune and reshuffles itself to meet each new threat.
features: At the start of your turn, choose a damage type; you gain resistance to it until your next turn.
Allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC while you are not incapacitated.
Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 hit points, the armor rebuilds you with hit points equal to half your maximum.
evolves: Feeding the lining a second Rune lets you pick two resistances per turn.
cost: The armor randomises one feature's appearance each dawn, and you never look the same twice.

requires: Artificer level 5, Artillerist subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, hit a bell at the top of the tower from the ground floor with your cannon.
secret: You must have landed 200 cannon shots without ever harming an ally.
notice: [Hidden job change. Range limit removed. Please aim responsibly.]
blurb: An Artillerist who builds one long cannon for extreme range, a siege sniper rather than a turret crew.
features: Your cannon's range triples and ignores half and three-quarters cover.
Mark a point; your next cannon attack there deals an extra 2d8 damage.
Once per long rest, hit a seen target within 1 mile for 10d10 force damage.
evolves: At level 15, after 50 kills from beyond 300 feet, you can fire over walls at a mapped target.
cost: Firing the long barrel deafens you for 1 minute.

n: Fireworks Master of the Lantern Fair
requires: Artificer level 11, Artillerist subclass, Engineering profession level 3
unlock: Put on a fireworks show in the Fogglass Spire bright enough to burn off the fog on floor 11 for one minute.
secret: You must have entertained a crowd of 100 people with your cannons without killing anything that day.
notice: [Hidden job change. The sky was always the best canvas.]
blurb: Cannon shells become festival rockets, dazzling, blinding and spreading wild coloured flame.
features: Your cannon's blast blinds creatures within 10 feet of impact until your next turn (Con save).
Allies who see your fireworks gain advantage on saves against fear.
Once per long rest, launch nine shells at once; each hits a different point for 5d6 fire and radiant damage.
evolves: At level 21, the fireworks can write words in the sky readable for 10 miles.
cost: Everything you own smells of black powder; stealth checks are at disadvantage.

requires: Artificer level 21, Artillerist subclass, holds the Comet or Star Rune
unlock: Shoot a falling star out of the Choir Spire's sky on floor 22 and load its core into your cannon.
secret: You must have fired at the night sky every night for a month before the climb.
notice: [Hidden job change. Ammunition source: the heavens.]
blurb: The cannon fires captured starfire, slow to reload but enough to crater a battlefield.
features: Cannon damage becomes radiant and ignores resistance.
Cannon hits tether the target; it cannot fly or teleport until your next turn.
Once per long rest, call a falling star to a point within 1 mile: 20d6 fire and radiant in a 40-foot radius (Dex half).
evolves: Gaining a contract with a star god lets you fire it twice per long rest.
cost: The cannon cools for 1 minute after each Starcore round and cannot fire again.

requires: Artificer level 5, Battle Smith subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, rebuild a wrecked pack of metal hounds and lead them through the floor without losing one.
secret: You must have repaired your steel defender after 20 separate destructions.
notice: [Hidden job change. One defender was lonely. Now it has a pack.]
blurb: This Battle Smith splits the steel defender into a pack of smaller hounds that hunt together.
features: Your defender becomes three Small hounds, each with a third of its hit points, acting on your command.
Hounds gain advantage on attacks against a creature adjacent to another hound.
Once per long rest, every hound takes an extra turn and deals 2d8 extra damage.
evolves: At level 15, a fourth hound can be built from a Mysterious-grade core.
cost: If any hound is destroyed, the rest lose a turn mourning it.

requires: Artificer level 11, Battle Smith subclass, Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: Forge a weapon for your defender on the Fogglass Spire's floor 12 using a hammer your reflection hands you.
secret: You must have forged the defender's every replacement part yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Two anvils, one rhythm.]
blurb: Maker and machine strike as one, forging weapons in combat and fighting in perfect rhythm.
features: When you and your defender hit the same creature in one round, it takes an extra 2d10 force damage.
As a bonus action, give your or the defender's weapon a material's Potency until the end of combat.
Once per long rest, you and the defender each attack three times against one target.
evolves: At level 21, the defender can learn a profession and craft alongside you.
cost: Separated from the defender by more than 1 mile, you have disadvantage on crafting.

requires: Artificer level 21, Battle Smith subclass, a Minor contract with a forge god
unlock: Bring your defender to the Choir Spire's 23rd floor and have it judged worthy of a soul.
secret: The defender must have protected an ally from a killing blow at least 10 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your defender has asked for a name.]
blurb: The steel defender gains a soul through a forge god's blessing and becomes a true companion.
features: Your defender acts on its own initiative and can use its own reactions to protect allies.
The defender gains +2 AC and resistance to all damage but force.
Once per long rest, the defender returns from destruction instantly with full hit points.
evolves: Raising the contract to a Finger lets the defender gain hidden classes of its own.
cost: The defender can refuse orders it finds wicked.

requires: Artificer level 5, Plague Doctor subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, cure a village of illusory plague victims within an hour.
secret: You must have cured as many diseases as you have inflicted.
notice: [Hidden job change. The beak mask breathes both ways.]
blurb: A Plague Doctor who doubles as a healer, balancing infection and cure like scales.
features: When you infect a creature, an ally within 30 feet heals 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier.
Create a 15-foot cloud that blocks disease and poison effects for 1 minute.
Once per long rest, end all diseases on up to 10 creatures and heal each 4d8.
evolves: At level 15, you can draw a disease out of an ally and throw it at an enemy.
cost: You must treat any sick person you pass, or lose access to your Skills for a day.

requires: Artificer level 21, Plague Doctor subclass, holds the Plague, Blight or Rot Rune
unlock: Grow a living disease garden on floor 42 of the Sunken Spire and keep it alive for a week.
secret: You must have survived a disease you created yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. The rot listens to you.]
blurb: This Plague Doctor cultivates diseases like crops, harvesting them for weapons.
features: Plant a 20-foot zone that poisons enemies who enter it each turn (Con save).
Name a creature type; your diseases deal double damage to it.
Once per long rest, every enemy within 120 feet is infected and takes 6d10 necrotic damage per turn until cured.
evolves: Feeding a Void-grade culture to your garden lets diseases cross realms.
cost: Plants wilt near you, and animals flee from your presence.

requires: Artificer level 11, Plague Doctor subclass, Harvesting profession level 3
unlock: Harvest 100 leeches from the fog pools of the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 and breed a single giant one.
secret: You must have saved a life by bloodletting at least once.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bell rings when blood moves.]
blurb: Leeches and bells are the tools of this surgeon, who draws sickness out through blood.
features: As an action, set leeches on a creature: it takes 2d6 necrotic per turn and you heal half.
Ringing your bell reveals all diseased or poisoned creatures within 120 feet.
Once per long rest, draw all conditions from an ally and inflict them on an enemy within 30 feet.
evolves: At level 21, the giant leech can be ridden.
cost: Leeches need feeding daily; skip it and they feed on you.

requires: Artificer level 5, Runesmith subclass, Carving profession level 2
unlock: Etch a mark on each weapon of the 10 guards on the Milestone Spire's floor 10 during a fight without them noticing.
secret: You must have etched gear for 50 different people.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your marks spread faster than you can carve.]
blurb: This Runesmith etches enemy and ally gear alike, turning any weapon into a tool.
features: On a hit, etch a mark on the target's weapon; it deals half damage until removed.
As a bonus action, etch an ally's weapon for an extra 1d8 damage for 1 minute.
Once per long rest, all marked weapons within 60 feet attack their wielders.
evolves: At level 15, marks can be etched from 30 feet away by a thrown chisel.
cost: Marks you etch fade if you fall asleep.

requires: Artificer level 21, Runesmith subclass, holds any Rune
unlock: Copy the Rune you hold onto a weapon in the Shuffled Spire's floor 34, using a chisel that changes shape every minute.
secret: You must have etched over 300 temporary properties into gear.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Rune remembers its own echo.]
blurb: An Artificer who carves pale echoes of their held Rune into gear, so friends can borrow it.
features: Etch a faint version of your Rune on an item for 1 hour; its holder gains one minor effect of it.
Items bearing your echo give +1 AC to allies wearing two or more.
Once per long rest, all echo items flare for 1 minute, giving their holders your Rune's full power.
evolves: Holding a second Rune lets you carve two echoes at once.
cost: Every echo weakens your own Rune use; you lose one use per day per active echo.

requires: Artificer level 21, Runesmith subclass, Enchanting profession level 6, a contract with a forge god
unlock: Strike nine sacred anvils on the Choir Spire's floor 21 in a rhythm the forge god hums for you.
secret: You must never have charged money for an etching.
notice: [Hidden job change. The hammers ring in a choir.]
blurb: The etchings become sacred seals, permanent and blessed by a god of the forge.
features: Etchings last until dispelled, with a maximum of your Intelligence modifier active.
Sealed weapons deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage.
Once per long rest, make an item indestructible for 24 hours.
evolves: Gaining a Finger contract lets you seal Runes into gear permanently.
cost: The god demands you forge one gift for a temple each month.

requires: Artificer level 5, Soul Mechanist subclass
unlock: Free a trapped soul from a broken lantern on the Milestone Spire's floor 9 and ask its permission before housing it in a construct.
secret: You must never have forced an unwilling spirit into a machine.
notice: [Hidden job change. The spirit has agreed. It wants to help.]
blurb: This Soul Mechanist only uses willing spirits and keeps them in glowing lanterns.
features: Constructs powered by willing souls gain +1 to attack and damage.
Your lantern sheds light that reveals invisible creatures within 30 feet.
Once per long rest, all souls in your care manifest and each grants an ally a free attack.
evolves: At level 15, a spirit can return to its old body if one is found.
cost: Souls can leave if mistreated, taking their power with them.

requires: Artificer level 21, Soul Mechanist subclass, holds the Wraith or Spirit Rune
unlock: Buy 10 damned souls at the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor auction and give each a new body.
secret: You must have built a construct that outlived its own soul.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ledger accepts your purchase. Handle with care.]
blurb: An overseer who works damned spirits into tireless machines of war.
features: Constructs with damned souls deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage.
Enemies within 30 feet of your constructs have disadvantage on saves against fear.
Once per long rest, summon 6 spirit constructs for 1 minute with half your hit points each.
evolves: Owning 100 souls lets you build a construct the size of a fortress.
cost: The souls whisper at night; you sleep only 4 hours per long rest.

requires: Artificer level 11, Soul Mechanist subclass, Tinker's tools and Enchanting profession level 3
unlock: Build a talking machine on floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire that lets a ghost speak to its living family.
secret: You must have helped 10 spirits find peace.
notice: [Hidden job change. The machine speaks with the dead.]
blurb: This Soul Mechanist builds machines that let ghosts speak and the living listen.
features: Speak with any spirit or dead creature within 60 feet for up to 10 minutes.
Ask a spirit one question; it must answer truthfully.
Once per long rest, a dead ally possesses a construct and fights for 1 minute with their old skills.
evolves: At level 21, the machine can hold a spirit long enough to be revived.
cost: Spirits come to you uninvited, asking for help.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Blood Titan subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, fight the floor guardian while spending at least half your hit points on growth and still win.
secret: You must have dropped below 10 hit points in 30 separate fights and never been knocked out.
notice: [Hidden job change. Blood spent: enough. Size limit: removed.]
blurb: A Blood Titan who keeps pouring blood into size until they tower over the field.
features: Each 10 hit points spent increases your size by one step, up to Huge.
While Large or bigger, your moves knock adjacent foes prone (Str save).
Once per long rest, become Gargantuan for 1 minute; your attacks deal an extra 3d10 damage.
evolves: At level 15, you can stay Large indefinitely after spending blood.
cost: Shrinking back leaves you with one level of exhaustion.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Blood Titan subclass, a Minor contract with a war god
unlock: Pay the Ledger Spire's 21st floor toll in your own blood, filling a bronze cup to the brim three times.
secret: You must have spent more than 5,000 total hit points on Blood Titan features.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ledger has credited your blood.]
blurb: This Blood Titan's spent blood is banked in Hell and repaid as raw power.
features: Blood spent on growth is stored; you can spend it later for 1d6 extra damage per 5 stored.
While you have stored blood, you have resistance to all damage.
Once per long rest, spend all stored blood to deal 1d10 damage per 5 stored to one target.
evolves: Raising the contract lets you bank allies' blood as well.
cost: Stored blood can be stolen by devils if you are knocked out.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Blood Titan subclass, holds the Bones or Iron Rune
unlock: Let the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 mirror crack your bones, then reset each one yourself.
secret: You must have had every major bone broken at least once.
notice: [Hidden job change. Bones hardened. Blood optional.]
blurb: A Blood Titan who hardens bones instead of growing, becoming a living wall.
features: Spending blood grants +1 AC instead of size for 1 minute.
As a reaction, take an ally's hit damage instead of them.
Once per long rest, become immune to all non-magical damage for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, your bones can be shed as weapons.
cost: You sink in water and cannot swim.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of Ruin subclass
unlock: Collapse the Milestone Spire's floor 8 walls with your bare hands in under 10 minutes.
secret: You must have destroyed 100 structures over your life.
notice: [Hidden job change. The rubble crowns you.]
blurb: This Barbarian rules the wreckage, turning broken terrain into weapons and thrones.
features: Throw rubble for 2d10 bludgeoning at a target within 60 feet.
Standing on difficult terrain grants you +1 AC.
Once per long rest, bring down a 30-foot cube of stone on enemies for 10d10 bludgeoning (Dex half).
evolves: At level 15, rubble you create can rebuild into walls on command.
cost: You cannot sleep in an intact building.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Path of Ruin subclass, holds the Earth or Destruction Rune
unlock: Shatter three floors of the Shuffled Spire before they shuffle, landing on the lowest.
secret: You must have ended a battle by breaking the ground under everyone.
notice: [Hidden job change. The land shakes to announce you.]
blurb: A Path of Ruin barbarian whose every stomp is an earthquake.
features: Your melee hits create a 30-foot crack; creatures on it fall prone.
Enemies knocked prone by you take 3d8 bludgeoning each time they stand.
Once per long rest, split the ground in a 120-foot line; creatures fall 60 feet into it.
evolves: Holding a second Rune lets the cracks spit lava.
cost: Buildings near you crack over time; no innkeeper will host you twice.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of Ruin subclass, Scavenging profession level 4
unlock: Demolish a fog-built town on floor 12 and salvage at least 100 usable parts.
secret: You must have sold more salvage than any other material.
notice: [Hidden job change. Demolition licensed.]
blurb: Ruin as a trade, this barbarian smashes for salvage and knows where every wall is weakest.
features: Your attacks deal double damage to objects and constructs.
When you destroy an object, gain temporary hit points equal to your Barbarian level.
Once per long rest, destroy a structure up to 100 feet without harming creatures you choose.
evolves: At level 21, you can find hidden rooms by smashing walls.
cost: You are always followed by a guild debt for collateral damage.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Path of Wild Magic subclass, holds the Gamble or Probability Rune
unlock: Roll every die in the Shuffled Spire's dice-hall on floor 31 and rage through what each one summons.
secret: You must have rolled a natural 1 on a wild surge 20 times without dying.
notice: [Hidden job change. The dice are on your side, mostly.]
blurb: This Barbarian learns to pick the wild surge, bending luck itself.
features: Roll twice on the wild surge table and choose.
Once per turn, reroll any damage die.
Once per long rest, choose any surge result and apply it at double strength.
evolves: Holding a second luck Rune lets allies use your rerolls.
cost: Bad luck finds you outside combat; you roll with disadvantage when gambling.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of Wild Magic subclass
unlock: Rage for one full hour on the Milestone Spire's floor 7 without a single surge harming an ally.
secret: You must have triggered a wild surge 100 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. The leak is steady now. Use it.]
blurb: Leaking magic becomes fuel; this barbarian rages harder the more mana spills.
features: Each wild surge adds 1d6 force damage to your attacks for 1 minute.
When you rage, spellcasters within 15 feet have disadvantage on concentration.
Once per long rest, release all stored mana: 8d8 force in a 30-foot radius.
evolves: At level 15, you can trade surges for spell slots.
cost: Magical items you touch while raging lose a charge.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of Wild Magic subclass, a Minor contract with a magic god
unlock: Let a hedge-witch spirit on the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 sew a charm into your skin while you rage.
secret: You must have spent at least a season living with a hedge-witch.
notice: [Hidden job change. The witch's charm hums in your veins.]
blurb: A wild rager guided by a folk witch's charm, turning chaos into small useful spells.
features: When you surge, also cast a 1st level spell of your choice for free.
As a bonus action, end your rage early to heal 3d8.
Once per long rest, every ally within 30 feet gains a beneficial surge result.
evolves: At level 21, the charm can be sewn into allies.
cost: The witch can ask a favour once a season.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of the Ancestral Guardian subclass
unlock: Carry your clan's oldest relic up 10 floors of the Milestone Spire without letting it be touched.
secret: You must know the names of seven generations of your ancestors.
notice: [Hidden job change. The old ones step closer.]
blurb: Ancestral spirits gather thicker around this barbarian, shielding the whole party.
features: Allies within 10 feet gain resistance to the first hit each turn.
Spirits deal 2d8 force to enemies who attack an ally.
Once per long rest, every ancestor manifests; allies are immune to damage for 1 round.
evolves: At level 15, you can bind a fallen ally's spirit as an ancestor.
cost: Ancestors judge your conduct; dishonourable acts silence them for a week.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of the Ancestral Guardian subclass, Cooking profession level 3
unlock: Hold a feast for the dead on floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, setting a place for every ancestor that arrives.
secret: You must have fed a stranger's ghost before.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ancestors have eaten. They stay.]
blurb: An ancestral guardian who feeds the dead and is fed strength in return.
features: On a short rest, an offering grants you 1 ancestral boon for the next fight.
Spirits can scout within 1 mile for 10 minutes.
Once per long rest, ancestors heal all allies within 60 feet to full.
evolves: At level 21, ancestors can answer questions about the past.
cost: You must set an extra place at every meal.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Path of the Ancestral Guardian subclass, holds the Spirit or Legacy Rune
unlock: Open a barrow gate on the Choir Spire's floor 22 and lead lost souls back to rest.
secret: You must have defended an ally's grave from desecration.
notice: [Hidden job change. The barrow opens. The ancestors kneel.]
blurb: Guardian of the gate between living and ancestor, this barbarian commands spirits in battle.
features: Summon 4 ancestral warriors for 1 minute with your AC and a quarter of your hit points.
Undead within 30 feet cannot regain hit points.
Once per long rest, 20 spirits fight beside you for 1 minute.
evolves: A contract with a death god lets ancestors carry your allies back from death.
cost: You must spend one night a month guarding a grave.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of the Battlerager subclass, Blacksmithing profession level 2
unlock: Hammer a spike into your armor for every enemy on floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, then crush them all at once.
secret: You must have won 50 grapples in spiked armor.
notice: [Hidden job change. More spikes. More problems. For them.]
blurb: Armor bristling with spikes, this battlerager turns every hug into a slaughter.
features: Grappled creatures take 2d6 piercing at the start of each turn.
Creatures that grapple or touch you take piercing equal to your Strength.
Once per long rest, deal 10d10 piercing to a grappled creature.
evolves: At level 15, spikes can be launched as projectiles.
cost: Sleeping in your armor is impossible, and so is hugging friends.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of the Battlerager subclass
unlock: Win the endless tavern brawl on the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 while drunk.
secret: You must have started and won 30 tavern fights without killing anyone.
notice: [Hidden job change. Bar tab paid. Barstool now a weapon.]
blurb: A battlerager made for chaos in close quarters; furniture and fists are weapons.
features: Improvised weapons deal 2d6 and count as magic.
Drinking a potion or ale grants resistance to bludgeoning for 1 minute.
Once per long rest, attack every creature within 10 feet three times.
evolves: At level 21, you can turn any room into a battleground with hazards.
cost: Tavern owners recognise you and refuse service.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Path of the Battlerager subclass, a contract with a forge or thunder god
unlock: Ring a holy bell on Choir Spire's floor 23 by charging into it in spiked armor.
secret: You must have shielded a temple with your body.
notice: [Hidden job change. The god's hammer recognises your spikes.]

Once per long rest, become Huge and attack five times per turn for 1 minute.

cost: Your human face slowly takes on animal features.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of the Beast subclass, a Minor contract with a hunt god

Your attacks against marked prey deal an extra 2d10.
Once per long rest, teleport next to your marked prey.

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of the Berserker subclass

Bite as a bonus action for 1d8 piercing.

cost: You eat three times as much food.

requires: Barbarian level 11, Path of the Giant subclass, holds the Frost or Ice Rune

cost: Fire damage against you is doubled.

requires: Barbarian level 21, Path of the Giant subclass, a Minor contract with a titan or sky god

requires: Barbarian level 5, Path of the Storm Herald subclass

Allies gain resistance to necrotic damage.
Once per long rest, freed souls fight beside you for 1 minute.

Party gains a Skill check proficiency for a day.

requires: Bard level 5, College of Spirits subclass
unlock: Tell a story on floor 8 of the Milestone Spire that summons its hero's ghost.
secret: You must have told 100 different stories.
notice: [Hidden job change. The hero answers.]
blurb: A spirits bard who calls up story heroes to aid them.
features: Summon a story hero for 1 minute with your proficiency to attack.
Choose any spirit tale effect instead of rolling.
Once per long rest, summon three heroes.
evolves: At level 15, heroes can be bound to items.
cost: Heroes have opinions about your choices.

requires: Bard level 11, College of Spirits subclass, holds the Spirit Rune
unlock: Light a candle for every ghost on floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire and tell its story.
secret: You must have talked a ghost into peace.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ghosts gather round.]
blurb: A spirits bard who tells stories by candle, ghosts gathering to listen.
features: Ghosts can scout and speak through you.
Once per long rest, all ghosts within 1 mile fight for you.
evolves: At level 21, you can tell a ghost back to life.
cost: You must light a candle every night.

requires: Bard level 21, College of Spirits subclass, holds the Necromancy Rune
unlock: Sign the Black Book on Ledger Spire's floor 23.
secret: You must have raised an undead.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Black Book opens.]
blurb: A spirits bard who tells tales of the damned, calling them into service.
features: Summon damned spirits that deal 3d10 necrotic.
Undead within 60 feet follow your commands.
Once per long rest, summon a damned army for 1 minute.
evolves: A second Rune lets you write new tales of the damned.
cost: Living creatures distrust you.

requires: Bard level 5, College of Swords subclass
unlock: Defeat seven duellists on floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, one per step of a song.
secret: You must have won 30 duels.
notice: [Hidden job change. Seven steps. Seven strikes.]
blurb: A swords bard whose blade song strikes in rhythm.
features: Each step of movement before an attack adds 1 damage.
Once per long rest, attack seven times.
evolves: At level 15, steps can be taken in the air.
cost: You must duel anyone who challenges you.

requires: Bard level 11, College of Swords subclass, holds the Entertainment Rune
unlock: Run a circus on the Fogglass Spire's floor 12 and perform every act yourself.
secret: You must have performed in a circus.
notice: [Hidden job change. The show must go on.]
blurb: A swords bard who performs sword-swallowing and knife-throwing as combat.
features: Throw three knives as a bonus action.
Once per long rest, all enemies are distracted and lose their turn.
evolves: At level 21, you can run a travelling circus.
cost: You must perform weekly.

requires: Bard level 21, College of Swords subclass, a Minor contract with a war god
unlock: Sing your blade into a holy sword on Choir Spire's floor 22.
secret: You must have defended the weak 100 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your blade sings.]
blurb: A swords bard whose blade sings holy songs.
features: Once per long rest, deal 10d10 radiant to one target.
evolves: A Finger contract lets your blade sing across realms.
cost: Your blade must be blessed daily.

requires: Bard level 5, College of Valor subclass
unlock: Carry a banner through floor 10 of the Milestone Spire while allies fight beside you.
secret: You must have led a charge.
notice: [Hidden job change. The banner flies.]
blurb: A valor bard carrying a banner that inspires charges.
features: Allies within 30 feet gain +1 to hit.
Allies who move 20 feet gain +2d6 damage.
Once per long rest, all allies charge and attack.
evolves: At level 15, the banner heals.
cost: You must protect the banner.

requires: Bard level 11, College of Valor subclass, a Minor contract with a Norse god
unlock: Sing a hero's saga in the Fogglass Spire's frozen hall on floor 12.
secret: You must have composed a saga.
notice: [Hidden job change. The saga lives.]
blurb: A valor bard who sings sagas of heroes in frozen halls.
features: Allies gain temporary hit points equal to your Bard level.
Once per long rest, allies deal double damage for 1 round.
evolves: At level 21, your saga can be passed on.
cost: You must sing sagas weekly.

requires: Bard level 21, College of Valor subclass, holds the War Rune
unlock: Lead an army on Ledger Spire's floor 21.
secret: You must have commanded 100 soldiers.
notice: [Hidden job change. The army follows.]
blurb: A valor bard who leads armies with song.
features: Allies within 120 feet gain +1 to hit.
Command allies as a bonus action.
Once per long rest, all allies attack twice.
evolves: A second Rune lets you raise an army.
cost: You must lead from the front.

requires: Bard level 5, College of Whispers subclass
unlock: Spread a rumour across floor 8 of the Milestone Spire that turns the guards on each other.
secret: You must have ruined someone with a rumour.
notice: [Hidden job change. The rumour spreads.]
blurb: A whispers bard who spreads rumours like poison.
features: A rumour causes creatures to distrust each other.
Hear anything said about you within 1 mile.
Once per long rest, ruin a creature's reputation.
evolves: At level 15, rumours become truth.
cost: People distrust you.

requires: Bard level 11, College of Whispers subclass, holds the Mask Rune
unlock: Steal three faces from the mirror-folk on floor 11.
secret: You must have stolen an identity.
notice: [Hidden job change. Faces collected.]
blurb: A whispers bard who collects faces of the dead.
features: Once per long rest, become three people at once.
evolves: At level 21, you can give faces to others.
cost: Your own face fades.

requires: Bard level 21, College of Whispers subclass, a contract with a trickster god
unlock: Steal a secret from a devil on the Ledger Spire's floor 22.
secret: You must have run a spy network.
notice: [Hidden job change. Hell's secrets are yours.]
blurb: A whispers bard who runs a spy network across realms.
features: Once per long rest, learn any secret.
evolves: A Finger contract lets you spy on gods.
cost: Spies can betray you.

requires: Bard level 5, Warchanter subclass
unlock: Drum on floor 10 of the Milestone Spire to keep a march going for one day.
secret: You must have marched 1,000 miles.
notice: [Hidden job change. The host marches.]
blurb: A warchanter whose drums keep armies marching.
features: Once per long rest, all allies charge.
evolves: At level 15, drums can be heard 10 miles.
cost: You must drum daily.

requires: Bard level 11, Warchanter subclass, holds the Horn Rune
unlock: Sound a horn on the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 to break the fog line.
secret: You must have broken an enemy line.
notice: [Hidden job change. The horn breaks lines.]
blurb: A warchanter whose horn breaks enemy lines.
features: Once per long rest, enemies flee.
evolves: At level 21, horn can call allies.
cost: Horn is loud and alerts foes.

requires: Bard level 21, Warchanter subclass, a contract with a war god
unlock: Sing the war god's anthem on Choir Spire's floor 23.
secret: You must have sung at a war god's temple.
notice: [Hidden job change. The war god sings.]
blurb: A warchanter who sings the war god's anthem, empowering armies.
features: Once per long rest, allies become immune to damage for 1 round.
evolves: A Finger contract lets your anthem summon the god.
cost: You must fight in every war.

requires: Cleric level 5, Arcana Domain subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, hear the confession of a dying wizard and take on his last unfinished spell.
secret: You must have copied 20 spells from scrolls or spellbooks and prayed over each one.
notice: [Hidden job change. Prayer and formula now share one page.]
blurb: A cleric who keeps a spellbook as holy writ, praying wizard spells into being.
features: Prepare one wizard spell per spell level as a cleric spell.
Your counterspells and dispels heal the ally they protect for 2d8.
Once per long rest, cast two spells of 3rd level or lower in one action.
evolves: At level 15, the spellbook can be read aloud as a sermon that grants allies resistance to spells.
cost: Lose the spellbook and you lose every borrowed spell until you rewrite it.

requires: Cleric level 11, Arcana Domain subclass, holds the Mana or Magic Rune
unlock: Draw water from the mana well on floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire and bless it without spilling a drop.
secret: You must have restored spell slots to another caster 30 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. The well of power flows through your hands.]
blurb: A priest of the well who pours mana into allies like holy water.
features: Spend a spell slot to restore one of equal level to an ally.
Spells you cast at higher level gain +1d8 damage or healing per level.
Once per long rest, all allies regain a spell slot of 3rd level.
evolves: At level 21, the well can be planted in a temple.
cost: Running out of slots leaves you exhausted.

requires: Cleric level 21, Arcana Domain subclass, a contract with a magic god
unlock: Seal a rogue spell storm on the Choir Spire's floor 22 with a sigil drawn in your own light.
secret: You must have ended 10 magical disasters.
notice: [Hidden job change. The god grants you a seal.]
blurb: A cleric charged by a magic god to seal rogue magic across the realms.
features: As a reaction, seal a spell of 5th level or lower.
Once per long rest, seal a creature's magic for 1 day.
evolves: A Finger contract lets you seal Runes.
cost: You must respond to magical disasters.

requires: Cleric level 5, Astral Domain subclass
unlock: Stand under the falling stars on the roof of the Milestone Spire and catch one in a bell.
secret: You must have spent 100 nights stargazing.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bell pulls the stars.]
blurb: An astral cleric whose bell pulls creatures with star gravity.
features: Pull a creature 20 feet toward you (Str save).
Allies within 10 feet gain resistance to falling damage.
Once per long rest, increase gravity in a 30-foot area: enemies take 8d8 and fall prone.
evolves: At level 15, you can reverse gravity.
cost: You feel heavy during the day.

requires: Cleric level 11, Astral Domain subclass, Navigation profession level 3
unlock: Chart the false stars of the Fogglass Spire's floor 12 and name a new one.
secret: You must have navigated by stars.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stars align for you.]
blurb: A cleric who maps the constellations and draws power from them.
features: Once per long rest, deal 10d10 radiant in a 60-foot area.
evolves: At level 21, you can map other realms' stars.
cost: You are weak on cloudy nights.

requires: Cleric level 21, Astral Domain subclass, holds the Astral or Starlight Rune
unlock: Wander the Shuffled Spire's floors 31-34 in astral form for a full day.
secret: You must have traveled in astral form.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stars are your road.]
blurb: An astral cleric who walks between stars, untouchable.
features: Once per long rest, rain stars for 12d10 over 120 feet.
evolves: A second Rune lets you walk to other realms.
cost: Your body fades over time.

requires: Cleric level 5, Flame Domain subclass, Cooking profession level 2
unlock: Keep a hearth fire burning on floor 10 of the Milestone Spire through a night of rain.
secret: You must have kept a fire burning for a month.
notice: [Hidden job change. The hearth never dies.]
blurb: A flame cleric of the home fire, warming allies and burning intruders.
features: Allies within 30 feet heal 1d6 per turn.
Enemies entering your hearth take 2d8 fire.
Once per long rest, all allies heal to full.
evolves: At level 15, your hearth can be carried.
cost: You must keep a fire burning.

requires: Cleric level 21, Flame Domain subclass, holds the Fire or Ignis Rune
unlock: Judge a devil in fire on floor 23 of the Ledger Spire.
secret: You must have burned a wicked creature alive.
notice: [Hidden job change. The cinders judge.]
blurb: A flame cleric who judges sinners with fire.
features: Branded creatures take 3d8 fire each turn.
Once per long rest, burn a creature for 12d10.
evolves: A second Rune lets your fire burn souls.
cost: You must burn a sinner each month.

n: Lantern Monk of the Blue Flame
requires: Cleric level 11, Flame Domain subclass
unlock: Carry a blue flame through the fog of floor 11 without it going out.
secret: You must have meditated in fire.
notice: [Hidden job change. The blue flame is yours.]
blurb: A flame cleric whose blue fire heals and burns.
features: Burn away fog and illusions within 60 feet.
Once per long rest, deal or heal 10d10.
evolves: At level 21, your flame can cleanse curses.
cost: You are cold without fire.

requires: Cleric level 5, Forge Domain subclass, Blacksmithing profession level 3
unlock: Forge a holy hammer on floor 9 of the Milestone Spire from scrap of every floor.
secret: You must have forged 100 weapons.
notice: [Hidden job change. The anvil sings.]
blurb: A forge cleric whose hammer strokes are prayers.
features: Bless a weapon for +1 to hit for 1 day.
Once per long rest, forge a magic weapon in 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, you can forge holy armor.
cost: You must forge daily.

requires: Cleric level 21, Forge Domain subclass, holds the Metal Rune
unlock: Melt down a devil's idol on Ledger Spire's floor 22.
secret: You must have destroyed an idol.
notice: [Hidden job change. The idols melt.]
blurb: A forge cleric who melts down idols into weapons.
features: Destroy unholy objects with a touch.
Once per long rest, deal 12d10 fire to a fiend.
evolves: A second Rune lets you forge with gods' metal.
cost: You cannot own idols.

requires: Cleric level 21, Forge Domain subclass, a contract with a forge god
unlock: Cast a temple bell on the Choir Spire's floor 21 that rings with the choir.
secret: You must have built a temple.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bell rings.]
blurb: A forge cleric who casts holy bells, ringing blessings.
features: Ring a bell to heal allies 4d8.
Once per long rest, allies immune to fear and charm for 1 hour.
evolves: A Finger contract lets your bell call the god.
cost: You must ring the bell daily.

requires: Cleric level 11, Grave Domain subclass
unlock: Pole a ferry across the fog river of floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire carrying every waiting soul.
secret: You must have buried 100 bodies.
notice: [Hidden job change. The river awaits.]
blurb: A grave cleric who ferries souls across the last river.
features: Place a coin on a dying ally to stabilise them.
Teleport allies across water or chasms.
Once per long rest, send an undead to rest instantly.
evolves: At level 21, the ferry can bring souls back.
cost: You must pay the ferry coin.

requires: Cleric level 5, Grave Domain subclass, Harvesting profession level 2
unlock: Tend the graveyard on floor 7 of the Milestone Spire for a week and keep every grave undisturbed.
secret: You must have tended a graveyard.
notice: [Hidden job change. The yard is quiet.]
blurb: A grave cleric who keeps the dead resting.
features: Undead in your yard cannot rise.
Heal allies near graves for double.
Once per long rest, all undead within 60 feet fall.
evolves: At level 15, you can raise the dead to rest elsewhere.
cost: You must tend graves weekly.

requires: Cleric level 21, Grave Domain subclass, a contract with a death god
unlock: Record every death on the Ledger Spire's floor 22 in a book.
secret: You must have recorded deaths.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ledger of death is yours.]
blurb: A grave cleric who keeps the ledger of death.
features: Touch a creature to learn how many rounds it could survive at its current wounds.
Allies within 30 feet cannot fail death saves while you write.
Once per long rest, erase one death that occurred in the last minute; the creature returns at half hit points.
evolves: A Finger contract lets you write deaths.
cost: You must record every death you see.

requires: Cleric level 5, Gravecaller subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, guide one lost soul down to rest and one stray soul back into its body, both in the same night.
secret: You must have spoken with the dead of both a friend and an enemy.
notice: [Hidden job change. One lamp. Two roads. You walk both.]
blurb: A Gravecaller who carries a lantern down the road of the dead and back up again.
features: As a bonus action, your lamp either stabilises a dying ally or frightens an undead within 30 feet.
When an ally drops to 0, they stand at 1 hit point once per long rest.
Once per long rest, for 1 minute no ally within 30 feet can die and every undead takes 4d10 radiant each turn.
evolves: At level 15, the lamp lets a dead ally speak one last message to anyone they choose.
cost: Ghosts gather around your lamp every night asking for directions.

requires: Cleric level 11, Gravecaller subclass, holds the Banshee or Grief Rune
unlock: Answer the wail on the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 hilltop and calm the spirit making it.
secret: You must have predicted a death that came true.
notice: [Hidden job change. The wail is now your warning.]
blurb: A Gravecaller who hears the death-wail before it comes, warning and shielding the doomed.
features: You learn when any ally within 1 mile is about to drop below a quarter hit points.
Your wail deals 4d8 psychic to enemies within 30 feet (Wis save).
Once per long rest, prevent one death and give it to the attacker.
evolves: At level 21, the wail can be heard across realms.
cost: You hear every death within 1 mile.

requires: Cleric level 21, Gravecaller subclass, a contract with a death god
unlock: Argue a soul's release before the death court on the Sunken Spire's floor 44.
secret: You must have pleaded a soul's case before a god.
notice: [Hidden job change. You may speak in the court of the dead.]
blurb: An envoy between living and the death court, bargaining souls.
features: Revive a creature dead under 1 hour.
Once per long rest, free a soul from any binding.
evolves: A Finger contract lets you sit on the court.
cost: The court sends you errands.

requires: Cleric level 5, Knowledge Domain subclass
unlock: Find a hidden note in the margin of every book on floor 9 of the Milestone Spire.
secret: You must have annotated 100 books.
notice: [Hidden job change. The margins speak.]
blurb: A knowledge cleric who reads between lines and margins.
features: Learn a hidden truth about any object you read.
Gain proficiency in any skill for 1 hour.
Once per long rest, learn everything about a place.
evolves: At level 15, you can write notes into the world.
cost: You must read daily.

requires: Cleric level 11, Knowledge Domain subclass, holds the Foresee Rune
unlock: Ask the fog mirror on floor 12 a question and see the answer.
secret: You must have answered a riddle from a god.
notice: [Hidden job change. The mirror answers.]
blurb: A knowledge cleric who reads the future in fog mirrors.
features: Once per long rest, learn one future event.
evolves: At level 21, you can change one prophecy.
cost: You see deaths of friends.

requires: Cleric level 21, Knowledge Domain subclass, a contract with a knowledge god
unlock: Shelve every book on the Choir Spire's floor 22.
secret: You must have built a library.
notice: [Hidden job change. The god's shelf is yours.]
blurb: A knowledge cleric who keeps the gods' library.
features: Read a book about any god.
Once per long rest, know any fact.
evolves: A Finger contract lets you write gods' books.
cost: You must keep the library.

requires: Cleric level 5, Life Domain subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire a skirmish rages for 10 rounds; keep every one of the 12 tower soldiers above 0 hit points until the horn sounds.
secret: You must have stabilised 100 dying creatures by hand, without magic, before you entered.
notice: [Hidden job change. Casualties this battle: zero. The Order takes note.]
blurb: A Life cleric who works the front line like a battlefield surgeon, stitching and praying in the same breath.
features: As a bonus action, heal an ally within 5 feet for 2d8 plus your Wisdom modifier, and they stand up from prone for free.
When you cast a healing spell on one creature, two other allies within 30 feet regain half as much.
Once per long rest, for 1 minute any ally within 30 feet who drops to 0 hit points instead drops to 1.
evolves: At level 15, after saving 500 lives, you can reattach severed limbs on a short rest.
cost: You cannot walk past a wounded creature, friend or foe, without treating it.

requires: Cleric level 11, Life Domain subclass, Harvesting profession level 3
unlock: A dead orchard fills floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire; bring every tree back to fruit within one week using only prayer, water and your own hands.
secret: You must have revived a plant that a druid declared dead.
notice: [Hidden job change. The orchard remembers spring. So do you.]
blurb: Life magic flows into soil as well as flesh, and the land itself starts healing this cleric's allies.
features: Your healing spells also create a 10-foot patch of green where allies regain 1d8 hit points at the start of their turns for 1 minute.
On a long rest, grow fruits equal to your Wisdom modifier; each restores 3d8 hit points when eaten.
Once per long rest, revive a creature dead for no more than 1 minute, returning it with half its hit points.
evolves: At level 21, the orchard can be planted in another realm to ease its Realm Pressure by 1.
cost: You must tend living plants daily or your healing is halved.

requires: Cleric level 21, Life Domain subclass, a Minor contract with a healing god
unlock: On the Choir Spire's floor 23 a plague ward holds a hundred dying; bleed into the god's chalice until all are saved, and do not stop when you faint.
secret: You must have once given up your own healing so that a stranger could live.
notice: [Hidden job change. Covenant sealed in blood. Your veins now run with mercy.]
blurb: A Life cleric whose own blood becomes a sacrament, trading hit points for miracles.
features: Spend up to 30 of your hit points; one ally within 60 feet regains twice that amount.
Allies within 30 feet regain 1d10 hit points whenever you take damage.
Once per long rest, drop to 1 hit point and heal every ally within 120 feet to full, ending all conditions.
evolves: Raising the contract to a 1st Finger lets your blood revive a creature dead up to a day.
cost: Your blood is a prized reagent, and thieves and vampires hunt you for it.

requires: Cleric level 5, Light Domain subclass
unlock: Floor 9 of the Milestone Spire is locked in a night that never ends; climb its bell tower and ring in a dawn that the tower itself accepts.
secret: You must have been awake to watch 100 sunrises in a row.
notice: [Hidden job change. Dawn has a herald. Darkness has a deadline.]
blurb: A Light cleric who carries the first hour of morning, burning off night and the things that live in it.
features: As an action, shed dawn-light in a 60-foot radius for 1 minute; magical darkness inside it ends.
Undead and fiends that start their turn in your First Light take 2d8 radiant damage.
Once per long rest, ring dawn across 120 feet: enemies take 8d8 radiant (Con save half) and allies end one condition.
evolves: At level 15, your dawn can be kept burning for a full day over a town or camp.
cost: After sunset your Light spells deal half damage until midnight.

requires: Cleric level 11, Light Domain subclass, holds the Truth Rune
unlock: Every creature on the Fogglass Spire's floor 12 tells you a lie; find the single one that is true and shine your lantern on it.
secret: You must have exposed a liar in front of a crowd at personal cost.
notice: [Hidden job change. In this light, only the truth casts a shadow.]
blurb: Radiance becomes a tool of inquiry, cutting through fog, disguise and falsehood.
features: Creatures in your 30-foot lantern light cannot speak a deliberate lie (Cha save each turn).
As a bonus action, a 60-foot line of light reveals invisible creatures and ends disguises and illusions it touches.
Once per long rest, every illusion within 300 feet ends and hidden creatures are outlined in light for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, the lantern can show the true form of a shapeshifter or possessed creature.
cost: You cannot lie either, even to protect a friend.

requires: Cleric level 21, Light Domain subclass, a Minor contract with a sun god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's floor 21, walk barefoot across the debtors' hall of burning coal and then punch through the devil-cast darkness at its end.
secret: You must have confessed a real sin to your god and paid its penance in full.
notice: [Hidden job change. Penance accepted. The sun now lives in your hands.]
blurb: A penitent Light cleric who sets down mace and shield to fight with fists of trapped sunlight.
features: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d10 plus Wisdom bludgeoning and 2d8 radiant damage.
You have resistance to necrotic and fire damage while you wear no armor.
Once per long rest, one punch deals 12d10 radiant damage and blinds the target for 1 minute (Con save half, no blindness).
evolves: A 1st Finger contract lets each strike leave a sunbrand that devils cannot heal.
cost: You must fast one day each week, or your fists cool to ordinary flesh.

requires: Cleric level 5, Nature Domain subclass
unlock: Plant a sapling on floor 6 of the Milestone Spire and protect it as the tower sends three waves of axe-bearing woodcutters.
secret: You must have planted at least 100 trees with your own hands.
notice: [Hidden job change. The grove has chosen its keeper.]
blurb: A Nature cleric who plants a portable sacred grove and fights from inside it.
features: As an action, raise a 20-foot grove for 1 minute; it is difficult terrain for enemies and allies inside have half cover.
Allies who start their turn in your grove regain 1d8 hit points.
Once per long rest, your grove becomes 60 feet and its trees attack enemies inside for 3d8 bludgeoning each turn.
evolves: At level 15, a grove you tend for a month becomes permanent and acts as a shrine.
cost: You cannot knowingly burn or cut a living tree without losing your Skills for a day.

requires: Cleric level 11, Nature Domain subclass, holds the Tame Rune
unlock: Gather the scattered fog-beasts of the Fogglass Spire's floor 11 into a single herd and lead them through the mist without losing one.
secret: You must have spent a full season as a shepherd or herder.
notice: [Hidden job change. The herd knows your whistle.]
blurb: A Nature cleric who keeps a herd of wild beasts like a shepherd, and they fight like one.
features: Beasts of CR 2 or lower within 60 feet are charmed by you and follow simple commands.
As an action, your herd charges a 60-foot line for 4d10 bludgeoning (Dex save half) and knocks creatures prone.
Ultimate: Call of the Wide Field
Once per long rest, summon a herd of 12 beasts of CR 3 or lower for 1 hour.
evolves: At level 21, the whistle reaches monstrosities, not just beasts.
cost: Animals trail after you everywhere, and you must feed them.

requires: Cleric level 21, Nature Domain subclass, a Minor contract with a nature god
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire, grow a thorn hedge that survives every reshuffle for one full day.
secret: You must have sworn a vow to defend a forest and kept it through a battle.
notice: [Hidden job change. The thorn remembers the vow.]
blurb: A Nature cleric sworn to a god of wild places, whose vow takes root as a thorn that obeys no realm's rules.
features: As an action, raise a 60-foot thorn wall; creatures passing through take 4d8 piercing.
Enemies you hit are restrained by brambles until they succeed on a Strength save.
Once per long rest, thorns fill a 300-foot area for 10 minutes; only you and chosen allies move through freely.
evolves: A 1st Finger contract lets the thicket hold its shape in any realm, ignoring Realm Pressure.
cost: You cannot cut, harvest or trample plants yourself.

requires: Cleric level 5, Order Domain subclass
unlock: Hold court on floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, judging three accused and getting every verdict right according to the tower's hidden record.
secret: You must have presided over a real trial and ruled against a friend.
notice: [Hidden job change. Court is in session.]
blurb: An Order cleric who carries a gavel instead of a mace, turning combat into a courtroom.
features: When you hit with the gavel, the target must obey a one-word command on its next turn (Wis save).
Creatures that ignore your command take 2d8 psychic damage.
Once per long rest, name a crime; a creature guilty of it is stunned for 1 minute (Wis save each turn).
evolves: At level 15, you can set up a court anywhere that binds witnesses to the truth.
cost: You must judge fairly, even when it favours your enemies.

requires: Cleric level 21, Order Domain subclass, holds the Law or Rules Rune
unlock: On the Choir Spire's floor 22, enforce the statute of the choir for a day, arresting anyone who breaks it, even angels.
secret: You must have arrested someone more powerful than you.
notice: [Hidden job change. The statute has a sentinel.]
blurb: An Order cleric who enforces heaven's statute, laying down rules that bind a battlefield.
features: Declare a rule within 60 feet for 1 minute; creatures who break it take 4d10 radiant.
Once per long rest, declare three statutes at once for 10 minutes.
evolves: Holding a second Rune lets statutes last a day.
cost: You must obey your own statutes.

requires: Cleric level 21, Order Domain subclass, a Minor contract with a law god
unlock: Collect the overdue tithes owed on the Ledger Spire's floor 21 from three devils without breaking a single clause of their contracts.
secret: You must have collected a debt from someone who had no way to refuse.
notice: [Hidden job change. Tithes are due. Payment is not optional.]
blurb: An Order cleric who enforces debts as divine law, taking from enemies what they owe.
features: When you hit, take 2d10 temporary hit points from the target as tithe.
Learn a creature's debts, oaths and contracts by touch.
Once per long rest, a creature with unpaid debts takes 12d10 necrotic damage.
evolves: A 1st Finger contract lets you collect debts owed to gods.
cost: Commoners shun you; you cannot buy at fair prices.

requires: Cleric level 5, Peace Domain subclass, Cooking profession level 2
unlock: Two warbands fight on floor 8 of the Milestone Spire; set up a table in the middle and serve tea until both sit down.
secret: You must have made peace between two enemies over a shared meal.
notice: [Hidden job change. Tea is served. Weapons are left at the door.]
blurb: A Peace cleric whose tea ceremony is a ritual of calm, binding drinkers together.
features: As an action, a creature who accepts your tea cannot attack for 1 minute (Wis save if hostile).
Allies who drink with you share your Emboldening Bond bonus for 1 hour.
Once per long rest, all creatures within 60 feet stop fighting for 10 minutes unless attacked.
evolves: At level 15, tea brewed with a high-grade leaf heals its Potency in hit points.
cost: You must offer tea before any fight you start.

requires: Cleric level 11, Peace Domain subclass, Tailoring profession level 3
unlock: Gather a thread from every enemy on the Fogglass Spire's floor 12 and weave them into one tapestry that hangs in the fog.
secret: You must have woven a gift for someone who once wronged you.
notice: [Hidden job change. The threads are tied. So are the hearts.]
blurb: A Peace cleric who weaves hearts together, binding allies so they share each other's burdens.
features: Link two willing creatures; damage to one is split between them.
Linked creatures gain +1 AC and advantage on saves against charm.
Once per long rest, link all allies within 60 feet for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, you can weave treaties between whole villages.
cost: You feel every hurt done to a linked creature.

requires: Cleric level 21, Peace Domain subclass, a Minor contract with a peace god
unlock: Raise a white flag on the Choir Spire's floor 23 between two warring angel hosts, and hold it while both test you.
secret: You must have ended a war or a blood feud.
notice: [Hidden job change. Truce declared. Heaven witnesses.]
blurb: A Peace cleric who carries a god's white flag; where it flies, violence falters.
features: Plant the flag; creatures within 30 feet have disadvantage on attacks while it stands.
Allies within 30 feet of the flag gain resistance to all damage.
Once per long rest, no creature within 120 feet can deal damage for 1 round.
evolves: A 1st Finger contract lets your flag halt battles between realms.
cost: You cannot strike a creature first.
